purpose: Font cache correctness and final two-product latency confirmation after removing the plain-candidate fast path
order_balance: Exactly three ABBA and three BAAB blocks per VM, shuffled using the fixed seed
unit: One paired observation per four-process block: mean(current pair) minus mean(baseline pair); report each VM separately
primary: First actual i injection DOWN to IME window UP
secondary: First candidate window UP to editor InputConnection
First planned n DOWN to ni event
All injection lateness and actual holds
Warm rounds 2-6 as a within-process median, separate from first
correctness: Separate disposable VM: baseline must fail exactly the unchanged-text/new-typeface-width assertion; current same test and all three candidate pixel/rendering tests must pass
rules: Keep every valid unfavorable result; never repeat an accepted sample to improve numbers
Preserve setup failures and exact APK/probe/SDK/signer identities
No P95, phone, Release, first unbound engine startup or visible-screen latency claims
Report positive deltas and uncertainty; no post-hoc pass threshold or general speedup claim
